test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

In this cold weather, / there’s nothing / like good / cup of coffee.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**a**" before the term "**good cup of coffee**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article** ("a" or "an").**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**like a good cup of coffee**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In this cold weather, there’s nothing** like a good **cup of coffee."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) cup of coffee** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2) In this cold weather** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4) there’s nothing** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
